result.title: ReFrame: Silence-Aware Compute Reclamation for Full-Duplex Speech Models
result.summary: Full-duplex speech models execute dense model inference for every audio frame throughout a live interaction. This uniform framewise schedule creates sustained GPU load across dialogue states whose computation has strong, reusable temporal structure. ReFrame formulates full-duplex inference as a silence-aware computation problem. Mutual Silence Speculation (MSS) operates when both participants are silent: it evaluates multi-frame Temporal continuations, verifies text and hidden-state stability, and applies batched Mimi audio-token correction. Listening Frame Folding (LFF) operates while the user speaks and the agent listens: it processes already-arrived user frames through parallel Temporal execution and frame-batched audio-token generation while accepting only the verified prefix. Frame-Budget Reinvestment (FBR) assigns the released frame intervals to resumable external retrieval and language-model workers, then injects timely references through Moshi's conditioning interface. We instantiate ReFrame on five full-duplex models spanning Moshi-family, phase-structured, and flattened autoregressive generation. Across the complete 1,225-conversation FDBench, ReFrame reduces measured GPU execution time by 18.80-31.01% and retains 96.92-100% non-PAD text agreement on five different models. On HaluEval tests, FBR increases the number of correct generated spoken answers from 86 to 205 under the same auxiliary-service budget. ReFrame turns recurring dialogue structure into lower inference cost and higher end-to-end service capability.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ReFrame，把全双工语音模型的逐帧密集推理重新表述为静音感知的计算问题：在双方静音时做多帧连续推测并校验文本与隐藏状态稳定性，在用户说话时并行处理已到达帧且只接受已验证前缀，并把释放的帧预算转投外部检索与语言模型工作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多帧推测＋隐藏状态稳定性校验＋仅接受已验证前缀」的机制，可供核查作为 latent 推理轨迹的验证、提前停止与计算回收线索；但该工作是语音对话推理加速，未涉及视觉证据或 LVR 状态生成，迁移性属推测。
